faqs.q: Which anime should a beginner watch first?
faqs.a: Shorter, self-contained series such as Death Note, Erased or Parasyte are easy starting points because they tell a complete story without needing hundreds of episodes. Once you know what you enjoy, you can move on to longer series like Naruto or One Piece, which ask for a much bigger time commitment.

faqs.q: Is it better to watch anime subbed or dubbed?
faqs.a: It comes down to personal preference. Subtitled versions keep the original Japanese voice acting, while dubs let you follow the action without reading. Many popular series are available with English dubs, and a growing number also have Hindi and other Indian-language dubs, so try both and see which you enjoy more.

faqs.q: What is the difference between anime and manga?
faqs.a: Manga are Japanese comics, usually printed in black and white, while anime is Japanese animation for television, streaming or cinema. Many popular anime, including most on this list, are adapted from manga, and the anime may change the pacing, skip some parts or add extra episodes not found in the original.
